subject: Capacity contingency check & provisional standby for Maelstrom (MSTRM-4821)
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Capacity check - Maelstrom late-stage (MSTRM-4821)

Team —

Maelstrom (Elena Sokolova) is in final contract talks and wants a firm assurance we can reserve capacity for their expected go-live window (early Sept). Sales asked for a short contingency/standby hold so procurement can align contracts. Key sizing details from the Maelstrom architecture doc attached: Maelstrom_capacity_spec.xlsx. Summary below: 

- Desired start: week of 2026-09-06
- Duration: initial 3 months standby, then month-to-month
- Instance footprint: 4 x A100 80GB per dedicated pool (they expect 2 pools for redundancy) -> total 8 x A100 80GB reserved
- Average concurrency target: 30 concurrent streams, median sequence length ~1,200 tokens
- Expected steady-state TPS: ~35 tokens/s across the pools (spiky during batch jobs)

Please confirm current availability in us-west-2 and whether we can place a provisional hold (no-charge or nominal fee) for a 14-day window while contracts finalize. Also flag any infra risk (node shortages, cross-region constraints).

Asks:
- Neha: quick availability report and activation lead-time (hours/days)
- Marcus/Aditya: if hold is possible, can you draft the provisional standby terms we give procurement? Vivek: copy for the sales thread to Maelstrom.

Thanks,

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 18:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Capacity check - Maelstrom late-stage (MSTRM-4821)

Tessa —

Quick readout after an initial cluster query (attached): capacity-availability-report-20260820.pdf. High-level:

- us-west-2 currently has spare A100-80 inventory across two clusters that can meet the 8 x A100 requirement starting 2026-09-06.
- Activation lead time: 48–72 hours to spin isolated dedicated pools and run the standard pre-warm (KV cache warmup + test-suite).
- Risk: we have a planned maintenance window on 2026-09-10 in cluster-west-2 that affects one of the candidate racks — can avoid by placing nodes in cluster-west-3 but that increases network egress for their traffic by ~3–4ms p99.
- Billing note: to lock capacity we recommend a provisional hold ticket that marks the nodes for 14 calendar days; if they request a hard reserve longer term, finance will need to sign a short-term commitment (we can quote).

I can open the provisional hold once sales confirms and provides the internal approval tag ("sales-provisional:MSTRM-4821"). Attaching the quick availability report for Ops.

Neha Kapoor
Capacity Planning Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachment: capacity-availability-report-20260820.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Capacity check - Maelstrom late-stage (MSTRM-4821)

All —

Agree with Neha. From an account-side perspective we should offer a 14-day provisional standby at a nominal monthly commitment (e.g., 10% of the first-month reserved price) to avoid tying up inventory indefinitely. Legal prefers a short LOI (two weeks) that confirms the standby and outlines activation lead-time.

Action items:
- Vivek: I'll hand off the draft provisional standby terms (one paragraph + activation SLA) to you for review.
- Tessa: confirm internal tag for Ops when we want the hold opened.

I'll prepare the one-paragraph standby and share in the thread in the morning.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Sokolova <elena@maelstrom.ai>, procurement@maelstrom.ai
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 13:27:00 +0000
Subject: Provisional standby offer and next steps (Maelstrom — MSTRM-4821)

Elena / Maelstrom procurement —

Thanks for the productive conversations this week. To keep your go-live window secure while contracts are finalized, Redwood can offer a provisional standby allocation with the following high-level terms: 

- Coverage: reservation of up to 8 x A100 80GB (2 pools of 4) in us-west (preferred cluster to be confirmed by Ops)
- Standby window: 14 calendar days from the hold activation date
- Fee: nominal standby fee equal to 10% of the estimated first-month reserved cost (credited to first invoice if reserved capacity converts to a committed purchase within the standby window)
- Activation SLA: 48–72 hours to provision and hand off the pools to Maelstrom once legal signature received and provisioning ticket confirmed
- Cancellation: no additional fees if Maelstrom declines within the 14-day window; fee if conversion request comes after window closes and capacity is no longer available

Attached is a short provisional-standby-agreement.pdf that captures the above in legal-friendly language. If this looks acceptable, sign the DocuSign placeholder (link below) and we will request Opsto open a provisional hold under tag "sales-provisional:MSTRM-4821".

DocuSign (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/doc/MSTRM-4821

Please reply with confirmation and preferred cluster (we recommend cluster-west-3 to avoid maintenance overlap).

Best,

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Attachment: provisional-standby-agreement.pdf

From: Elena Sokolova <elena@maelstrom.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, procurement@maelstrom.ai
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Provisional standby offer and next steps (Maelstrom — MSTRM-4821)

Vivek —

Thanks, that framework looks good and legal will review the LOI. Two quick clarifications before we sign: 

1) Can you confirm the exact node SKU (we need A100 80GB, NVLink enabled) and whether the standby pool can be created with the network configuration we described in the spec (private VPC peering + dedicated egress IPs)?

2) If we sign today, you mentioned a 48–72 hour activation SLA. If we need the capacity earlier (within 24 hours) are there escalation paths / warm standby options (higher fee) to guarantee <24h activation?

On the DocuSign link: procurement will ping once legal finishes the quick review.

Best,
Elena Sokolova
Head of Infrastructure | Maelstrom AI
